question: Which of the following article of Indian constitution deals with the Secretariat of State Legislature?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 187**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 187** of the **Constitution of India** specifically provides for the **Secretariat of State Legislature**. It ensures that each House of the State Legislature has its own dedicated administrative staff to maintain the independence of the legislative body from the executive.
 
• According to **Clause 1** of this article, each House of the Legislature of a State shall have a **separate secretarial staff**. However, in states with a **bicameral legislature** (having both a Legislative Assembly and a Legislative Council), nothing prevents the creation of posts common to both Houses.
 
• **Clause 2** empowers the **State Legislature** to make laws to regulate the **recruitment and the conditions of service** of persons appointed to the secretarial staff of the House or Houses.
